steps.title: Fewer than half are up to date.
steps.caption: At Michigan's 39 federally funded health centers, 48.7% of adults aged 46 to 75 were up to date on colorectal cancer screening in 2025. The target is 72.8%.
steps.spoken: [warm, confident storyteller] Fewer than half are up to date. At Michigan's thirty-nine federally funded health centers, forty-eight point seven percent of adults aged forty-six to seventy-five were up to date on colorectal cancer screening in twenty twenty-five. The target is seventy-two point eight percent.

steps.title: Every dot is a clinic.
steps.caption: Each dot is a clinic site, colored by its health center's rate: green at or above the target, deeper red the further below. Grey means HRSA did not publish a rate.
steps.spoken: [clear, inviting] Every dot is a clinic. Each dot is a clinic site, colored by its health center's rate: green at or above the target, deeper red the further below. Grey means Hersa did not publish a rate.

steps.title: Zoom in to where you work.
steps.caption: Jump to a region like Detroit, scroll to zoom, or search any center or city, including the names people actually use.
steps.spoken: [warm, a little playful] Zoom in to where you work. Jump to a region like Detroit, scroll to zoom, or search any center or city, including the names people actually use.

steps.title: Open any center.
steps.caption: Each center shows its rate, its eligible adults, and how many more screenings would reach the target. Every center has its own link you can share.
steps.spoken: [confident] Open any center. Each center shows its rate, its eligible adults, and how many more screenings would reach the target. Every center has its own link you can share.

steps.title: Put three side by side.
steps.caption: Patients, neighborhoods and resources differ, so a comparison starts a conversation. It does not settle one.
steps.spoken: [reflective, sincere] Put three side by side. Patients, neighborhoods and resources differ, so a comparison starts a conversation. It does not settle one.

steps.title: All 35 against one line.
steps.caption: Each dot is a center with a published rate. The dashed line is the target. Size the dots by eligible adults to see where the most people are.
steps.spoken: [clear, inviting] All thirty-five against one line. Each dot is a center with a published rate. The dashed line is the target. Size the dots by eligible adults to see where the most people are.

steps.title: Useful signals. Better questions.
steps.caption: Rural centers reached 57.8%, urban centers 43.9%, and 16 centers are more than 25 points below the target. The question is what stands in the way: access, outreach, kits returned, or follow-up.
steps.spoken: [with quiet conviction] Useful signals. Better questions. Rural centers reached fifty-seven point eight percent, urban centers forty-three point nine percent, and sixteen centers are more than twenty-five points below the target. The question is what stands in the way: access, outreach, kits returned, or follow-up.

steps.title: Move the goal. See what it takes.
steps.caption: Reaching 72.8% means 45,138 more adults screened. Even a goal of 60% would mean 21,122 more. It is arithmetic, not a forecast.
steps.spoken: [confident] Move the goal. See what it takes. Reaching seventy-two point eight percent means forty-five thousand, one hundred thirty-eight more adults screened. Even a goal of sixty percent would mean twenty-one thousand, one hundred twenty-two more. It is arithmetic, not a forecast.

steps.title: A test is only step one.
steps.caption: A screening rate cannot show whether a positive stool test led to a colonoscopy. The Completion Worklist is built for that step, and you can send two counts for a free one-page readout.
steps.spoken: [with quiet conviction] A test is only step one. A screening rate cannot show whether a positive stool test led to a colonoscopy. The Completion Worklist is built for that step, and you can send two counts for a free one-page readout.

steps.title: Public data. Not a ranking.
steps.caption: Every number comes from HRSA's public 2025 file, the methods are open, and the map is updated each year. A lower rate is a reason to look at barriers, not a judgment of care.
steps.spoken: [warm, inviting] Public data. Not a ranking. Every number comes from Hersa's public twenty twenty-five file, the methods are open, and the map is updated each year. A lower rate is a reason to look at barriers, not a judgment of care.
